services.name: View Charters
services.desc: Explore our charter options and choose the trip that fits your experience, interests, and ideal day on the Carolina waters. A half day on the water, and the trip most people book first. Four hours is enough to work the creeks, sandbars and oyster beds of Murrells Inlet, or run out to the nearshore reefs when conditions allow. It suits families, first timers, and anyone who wants the morning bite and the rest of the day free. Depending on season and conditions you may target flounder, redfish, speckled trout, black drum and Spanish mackerel. Our 3/4 Day Inshore Fishing Charter is the perfect middle ground, offering ample time on the water while keeping the day relaxed and flexible. This trip

includes: Top-tier gear from Shimano, Orvis, Minn Kota, Pathfinder Boats, and YETI
gap: Price for each charter duration not stated
blurb: Carolina Hook & Fly offers fishing charters on three purpose-built boats designed for different water conditions. Guests can choose from inshore, nearshore, or tarpon fishing trips. The company provides all necessary gear and expertise for a day of fishing.

quotes.text: Carolina Hook & Fly exceeded our expectations. The guides were true experts, sharing their knowledge of the local waters and helping us land some impressive catches. The emphasis on customer service was evident throughout the trip.

I HAD THE MOST INCREDIBLE FISHING EXPERIENCE WITH CAROLINA HOOK & FLY! THE EXPERTISE OF THEIR CAPTAINS IS UNMATCHED, AND THE ATTENTION TO DETAIL IN PROVIDING A TOP-TIER ADVENTURE IS TRULY COMMENDABLE.
